content.text:
Fixed. `to_cents` in `ledger/currency.py` used `int(amount * 100)`, which truncates. `19.99 * 100` is `1998.999…` in floating point, so it gave 1998 instead of 1999. I changed it to `round(amount * 100)`.

The full suite now passes (5 tests, including `test_report.py`).
